title: How the Tesla Roadster Hangs Upside Down
description:
The new Tesla Roadster hangs upside down because fans pull the air out from under the car while skirts seal the gap, so the outside air pins it to the ramp. Tesla says that push reaches up to twice the car's weight, and it holds even when the car is standing still. Then jets of compressed gas roll it the right way up before it lands. The trick itself isn't new: racing officials banned the Chaparral 2J's fans after the 1970 season.
